description: This PHP file defines a class 'ModuleNotAvailableSubscriber' that listens to HTTP request events within the OrangeHRM system. It detects if the requested module is disabled and throws appropriate exceptions to prevent access or forward the request accordingly.

classes.name: ModuleNotAvailableSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber class that intercepts HTTP requests to check if the requested modules are disabled and acts accordingly by throwing exceptions or forwarding requests.

methods.name: getModuleService
methods.description: Initializes and returns the ModuleService instance used to retrieve module information.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the kernel request event.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming request events; checks if the request targets a disabled module and throws appropriate exceptions to block or forward the request.
